thread_text:
jamie-peopleops: Quick ask  can we create a tiny reusable "Sprint Goal Card" ICs and managers can paste into 1:1s and performance touchpoints? Needs to be copyable and super short so folks actually use it.

ryan-engineer: Yes please. Something like a 6-line card that includes a single-sentence goal, a clear metric, one risk, one growth ask, and 1 next action.

maria-hrbp: Add a one-line "evidence for calibration" field too (paste 2 bullets with dates). Helps us during rating calibration without extra digging.

olivia-manager: Also example language for feedback snippets would be great  a positive, a corrective, and a growth-suggestion. Keep the tone concrete and behavioral.

jamie-peopleops: Draft below. Feel free to copy into your 1:1 note or past directly to a person post-meeting. I'll also add this card to the manager playbook and an optional calendar reminder for managers 2 weeks before cycle close.

---
`Sprint Goal Card (copyable)`

- Goal (1 line): [e.g., "Improve web inference p95 from 220ms to <=140ms by Q3"]
- Why it matters (1 line): [customer experience / revenue / cost impact]
- Success metric: [metric / target / baseline] (pick 1)
- Top risk/blocker: [e.g., GPU quota / model quality drift]
- Growth stretch: [skill or role stretch; e.g., lead cross-team perf playbook]
- Evidence for calibration (2 concise bullets with dates): [date  short fact]
- Next step (owner / due): [one next action + owner + due date]

`Manager feedback snippets (copyable)`
- Positive: "Thanks  your investigation reduced p95 by 30ms and prevented multiple customer tickets last month. Great follow-through."
- Corrective: "I noticed the rollback came late. Can we map what signals were missing and agree on a faster rollback checklist?"
- Growth suggestion: "Would you be interested in running the cross-team perf spike next sprint to build stakeholder management experience?"

`How to use`
- Timebox: keep the card to a 1015 minute section in a 1:1; if more, schedule a focused follow-up.
- Storage: managers, paste the completed card into the cycle calibration folder 10 days before calibration opens (only the short bullets needed).
- Calibration tip: include 23 short examples with dates and ideally a link to a PR/incident if available.
---

ryan-engineer: This is perfect  will paste into my 1:1 notes. Can we also make a tiny variant for IC self-reviews that prompts for "what I'd do differently"?

jamie-peopleops: Yup, will add a version for self-reviews in the playbook that flips "Manager feedback snippets" to "Self-review starter lines" (e.g., "I shipped X; next time I'd do Y to avoid Z").

olivia-manager: One operational Q: should managers share completed cards with direct reports before calibration or wait?

maria-hrbp: Share with the direct report during/after the 1:1. For calibration, managers should upload the short card into the calibration folder on the timeline we'll publish in the playbook. Full write-ups are optional.

notify-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Upload Sprint Goal Cards to calibration folder"  10 days before calibration window opens.

jamie-peopleops: Great, I'll finalize and add to the manager handbook. If anyone wants a branded Notion template or a Slack shortcut to paste the card, ping me and I can wire up a template/snippet.
